bio: Adam Hisham Hamawy (ٱدم هشام حموي; born 1969/1970) is an American plastic surgeon and former U.S. Army physician. Hamawy specializes in both cosmetic and reconstructive procedures at his practice in Princeton, New Jersey. He is the Democratic nominee for New Jersey's 12th congressional district after winning the 2026 Democratic Primary.
